items.title: Yash’s Toxic gets gag order against ‘false, defamatory’ content before Aug 26 release
items.summary: A Bengaluru court granted an ex parte temporary injunction restricting the publication or circulation of false, malicious, defamatory, or derogatory content on Kannada actor Yash’s upcoming film Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-Ups . The order was passed on an interim application filed by Toxic’s producers KVN Productions, which also sought a permanent injunction against a number of defendants, including X Corp and “John Doe @ Ashok Kumar,” referring to an unidentified person. The producers sought an order restraining the defendants from communicating, publishing, circulating, sharing, posting, streaming, providing access to, or otherwise communicating through any medium any “false, malicious, defamatory, derogatory” news concerning the film, either before or after its release. Unlike some previous injunctions obtained by film producers in Karnataka, the order in this case does not expressly restrain reviews or criticism of the film. Earlier orders sought to restrict a much broader range of online content, including reviews, videos, reactions, trolling, and even “challenging feedback”.
